android.desc:
Kyu Launcher gives you a fast, minimal, and smooth TV home screen built for real use.
No ads. No bloat. Just your apps — exactly where you want them.

Most Android TV launchers are heavy, slow, or filled with recommendations you don’t need.
Kyu Launcher focuses on speed, simplicity, customisation and control.

Ultra Fast Android TV Launcher – Smooth navigation with zero lag
Minimal TV Home Screen – Clean layout, no clutter, no distractions
Remote-Friendly Navigation – Designed for D-pad & TV remotes
Focus on Your Apps – No forced recommendations or content rows
Quick App Access – Launch apps instantly without digging through menus, arrange neatly in folders
Elder friendly – Simple, modern interface that can be used by less tech savy people too

Features

1. Folders: Arrange your apps in folders, or move them inside folders wherever you want
2. TV inputs: All your hdmi inputs in one place
3. Watch: A watch tab that tracks your currently watching shows so you can continue watching them and under that is a list of latest programs from your apps that you can customise
4. To-do list. Don't forget anything, write that on your tv's to-do list to access anytime
5. Themes: Pick from pre-loaded themes or create your own using your custom wallpapers and colors
6. Customisation: Tweak everything from wallpaper to colors to the apps/folders/tabs you want to hide
7. Private: No tracking no bloat simple and fast tv launcher



Works great on:

Android TV boxes
Smart TVs
Projectors
Google TV devices

(i) Watch tab features depend on device support and installed apps.
(ii) Some features like custom app icons require a one time premium upgrade

Accessibility Service Notice: Kyu Launcher includes an optional accessibility service, solely used to improve navigation by allowing custom actions via remote control shortcuts. No data is collected or shared.


Make your Android TV faster, cleaner, and easier to use for everyone with Kyu Launcher.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Kyu Launcher – Roku Interface on Your Android and Google TV

quotes.text:
Hey HN, I am the developer of the somewhat famous AT4K launcher an apple tv inspired android tv launcher. 
After launching AT4K I read somewhere in news that Roku is the highest selling Streaming box of US and that intrigued me to check out why.

Turns out it's because Roku is dead simple to use, your parents, grandparents can easily navigate around Roku and find apps and stuff to watch.

I thought well why not do this with AT4K so I wrote a lot of code to make an alternative view in AT4K that would look like that. But that didn't work and I had to branch out this to a new app but used most of the code from AT4K.

So here it is Kyu Launcher An Android TV Launcher built for everyone and their grandma. It's dead simple to use, you can create folders, hide apps, view your currently watching list, your spouse can even add to-dos/notes right at the launcher home page and you can hide most of the stuff you don't want. Here is the link:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.overdevs.kyulauncher

Recently Roku shoved down a new update to their interface and most people, as is the case with the design changes almost always, do not like it. If they want to ditch the Roku and want to keep the interface they can use Kyu to keep the Roku feel and enjoy their android tvs.

There are some beautiful themes too. I made it because I liked what I saw with Roku and wanted to port similar experience to Google TV devices. I also know it's not something with lots of bells and whistles …
